_comment: The exact verified TURBO text-to-image graph for Qwen-Image-2.1 Q4_K_M GGUF on a free T4 (Viggle turbo LoRA v0.2.1, r128). POST to /prompt wrapped as {"prompt": <this object>, "client_id": "x"}. Settings = the measured turbo combo: 768x768, 6 steps, CFG fully OFF (BasicGuider runs no negative pass), euler, runtime-hook LoRA at strength 1.0, seed 42 -> ~21 s warm. The LoRA must never be merged into the weights and the sigma schedule must stay ViggleTurboSigmas (stock samplers cannot express it). Requires the server-side viggle_turbo.py custom node (the notebook installs it) and the LoRA file in models/loras/. Baseline (no-LoRA) graph: workflows/t2i-api.json. Numbers trace to timings_v4_turbo.json in the GPUTests lab repo. See references/04-tweaking.md before changing values.
